profile.headline: SWE @ Mirketa
profile.summary:
I am a 4th-year computer science student at UC Davis, driven by my passion for technology and dedication to academic excellence. As an honor-roll student, I have consistently demonstrated a strong work ethic, adaptability, and commitment to achieving my goals.

My technical expertise spans multiple programming languages, including C++, C, and Python, as well as web development tools such as JavaScript, AWS, and MySQL. I have leveraged these skills to develop my website, DidYouNeed.Me, which streamlines users' online presence by consolidating multiple networks into one convenient location. This ongoing project showcases my ability to create practical, user-focused solutions using cutting-edge web technologies.

One of my primary interests within the computer science field is cybersecurity. I am eager to explore opportunities that allow me to combine my programming skills with my passion for protecting digital assets and ensuring the safety of online systems.

As I actively seek internships and job opportunities to further expand my knowledge in software development and cybersecurity, I welcome the opportunity to connect with like-minded professionals. Together, we can drive innovation, address critical security concerns, and shape the future of technology.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer at Mirketa, a Salesforce consulting partner that helps companies design, build, and optimize their CRM. I develop custom solutions with Apex, Lightning Web Components (HTML, JS, CSS), and Salesforce Flow, with a focus on Agentforce AI agents that automate customer service and internal workflows. Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist. I bring a full-stack background (Python/Django, REST APIs, AWS, Docker) to integration-heavy Salesforce work.
positions.insights: Agentic AI Development, Software Development and +3 skills

positions.title: IT Student Assistant
positions.description:
Work closely with faculty to assist students in COVID-era learning. Use my vast knowledge of computer software and hardware and a variety of internet applications, networks, and operating systems to maintain the college standard to build and maintain updated and efficient computer systems and networks to optimize the role of technology on business/educational sustainability for at-home learning.

-Maintain standards compliance.
-Implement localization or globalization of software.
-Protect operations by keeping information confidential.
-Tailor and deploy software tools, processes, and metrics.
-Maintain hardware and software functionality.
-Setting up workstations with computers and necessary peripheral devices
positions.insights: Debugging, Linux System Administration and +1 skill
